name: Ali Bayoumi
title: Planning & Project Controls Engineer
summary: Planning, scheduling, cost control and reporting — connecting the programme to the decisions that keep work moving.
about: I am a Planning & Project Controls Engineer with 4+ years of experience across construction, facilities management, technical office and site execution in Egypt and Saudi Arabia. My work connects schedules, progress information and technical deliverables, with project exposure at the Daba’a Nuclear Power Plant and Shura Island / Red Sea development.
education: Bachelor of Construction Engineering · Egyptian Russian University · 2021

experience.summary: Coordinated structural shop drawings, material take-offs, BOQs, RFIs and material submittals for fast-track works. Maintained approval and as-built records while resolving design and site interfaces.

Supported planning and technical office activities for Buildings 31/32 and 41/42. Tracked engineering submissions, approvals and constraints; supported progress monitoring, reporting and lookahead coordination.

Developed and maintained P6 and MS Project baselines and updates. Reviewed critical paths and float, prepared lookaheads and recovery actions, and reported progress, costs and KPI/SLA performance in Excel.
Coordinated daily site activities and progress reporting. Reviewed quantities, BOQs and contractor invoices, and supported quality inspections, snagging and technical coordination.
